university.name: Arts University Bournemouth
university.overview: A leading specialist arts institution providing studio-based education in film, fashion, and fine arts.
university.admission_requirements: Portfolio is mandatory; UCAS tariff 112-128; IELTS 6.0.

courses.title: BA (Hons) Acting
courses.overview: Practical training for stage and screen, emphasizing physical theatre and character development.
courses.modules: Performance Skills, Voice, Movement, Characterisation, Industry Practice

courses.title: BA (Hons) Animation Production
courses.overview: World-class degree covering 2D, 3D, and stop-motion animation pipelines.
courses.modules: Drawing for Animation, CGI, Narrative, Performance for Animation

courses.title: BA (Hons) Architecture
courses.overview: ARB/RIBA Part 1 accredited; focusing on the intersection of design, technology, and culture.
courses.modules: Design Studio, Technology, History and Theory, Environment

courses.title: BA (Hons) Business of Games
courses.overview: Focused on the commercial, marketing, and management side of the global gaming industry.
courses.modules: Game Economy, Publishing, Marketing, Project Management

courses.title: BA (Hons) Commercial Photography
courses.overview: Professional training in advertising, fashion, and editorial photography for the creative sector.
courses.modules: Studio Lighting, Digital Imaging, Visual Research, Professional Practice

courses.title: BA (Hons) Communication Design and Strategy
courses.overview: Examining how visual communication and design thinking can solve complex business challenges.
courses.modules: Design Thinking, Strategy, Branding, Content Creation

courses.title: BA (Hons) Content Creation with Marketing
courses.overview: Focused on digital storytelling and brand growth through cross-platform content strategy.
courses.modules: Social Media, SEO, Branding, Copywriting, Video Production

courses.title: BA (Hons) Costume
courses.overview: Focusing on the design and construction of garments for theatre and historical performance.
courses.modules: Garment Construction, Pattern Cutting, Costume History, Textiles

courses.title: BA (Hons) Costume for Film
courses.overview: Specialized training in creating character-driven costumes for screen and cinematic environments.
courses.modules: On-set Etiquette, Character Design, Construction for Camera

courses.title: BA (Hons) Creative Writing
courses.overview: Practical workshop-based study of fiction, poetry, and non-fiction with industry focus.
courses.modules: Narrative Theory, Creative Practice, Scriptwriting, Editing

courses.title: BA (Hons) Dance, Movement and Creative Practice
courses.overview: Developing versatile performers and choreographers for contemporary dance sectors.
courses.modules: Contemporary Technique, Choreography, Dance Science, Industry Skills

courses.title: BA (Hons) Fashion
courses.overview: Experimental and industry-aligned study of garment design, silhouette, and construction.
courses.modules: Design Process, Pattern Cutting, Fashion Illustration, Tailoring

courses.title: BA (Hons) Fashion Communication
courses.overview: Focused on fashion styling, art direction, and digital content for the global fashion industry.
courses.modules: Styling, Art Direction, Fashion Journalism, Digital Media

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Fashion Management and Strategy
courses.overview: Commercial focus on fashion supply chains, buying, and sustainable business growth.
courses.modules: Buying and Merchandising, Supply Chain, Strategic Marketing

courses.title: BA (Hons) Film Production
courses.overview: Highly technical and collaborative degree covering all aspects of cinematic production.
courses.modules: Cinematography, Directing, Producing, Editing, Sound Design

courses.title: BA (Hons) Fine Art
courses.overview: Studio-based degree exploring painting, sculpture, and contemporary installation art.
courses.modules: Studio Practice, Visual Theory, Art History, Professional Practice

courses.title: BA (Hons) Games Art and Design
courses.overview: Focused on the visual development and world-building of modern video games.
courses.modules: Concept Art, 3D Modelling, Environment Design, Engine Work

courses.title: BA (Hons) Graphic Design
courses.overview: Examines visual communication through typography, branding, and digital design systems.
courses.modules: Typography, Branding, Editorial Design, Digital Media

courses.title: BA (Hons) Illustration
courses.overview: Focusing on narrative imagery and personal visual language for commercial application.
courses.modules: Narrative Illustration, Drawing, Digital Imaging, Printmaking

courses.title: BA (Hons) Interior Architecture and Design
courses.overview: The creative reimagining of internal spaces through technical design and spatial planning.
courses.modules: Spatial Design, Technology, Design Theory, Drawing

courses.title: MA Animation Production
courses.overview: Advanced masters for professionals seeking specialized knowledge in animation pipelines.
courses.modules: Advanced Animation, Narrative Design, Research Methods

courses.title: Master of Architecture (Part 2)
courses.overview: Professional Part 2 qualification focusing on advanced architectural design and research.
courses.modules: Design Studio, Advanced Technology, Professional Studies

courses.title: MA Creative Writing (Online)
courses.overview: Part-time online master's for writers seeking to develop a major creative work.
courses.modules: Creative Practice, Narrative Theory, Professional Editing

courses.title: MA Fine Art
courses.overview: Intensive studio-based program for establishing a high-level personal art practice.
courses.modules: Advanced Studio, Visual Theory, Professional Engagement

courses.title: MA Graphic Design
courses.overview: Exploring experimental visual communication and design thinking at a strategic level.
courses.modules: Design Strategy, Brand Development, Visual Research

courses.title: BA (Hons) Acting for Screen
courses.overview: Specialized training for film, television, and digital media performance.
courses.modules: Acting for Camera, Screen Analysis, Voice, Industry Portfolio

courses.title: BA (Hons) Ceramics
courses.overview: Explores traditional and contemporary ceramic practice through material experimentation.
courses.modules: Clay Theory, Glaze Technology, Studio Practice, Visual Research

courses.title: BA (Hons) Creative Events Management
courses.overview: Focused on the production and management of festivals, exhibitions, and corporate events.
courses.modules: Event Planning, Digital Marketing, Risk Management, Production

courses.title: BA (Hons) Modelmaking
courses.overview: Technical training in physical modelmaking for architecture, film, and product design.
courses.modules: Prototyping, 3D Fabrication, CAD/CAM, Material Science

courses.title: BA (Hons) Performance Design and Film Costume
courses.overview: Combines scenography and costume design for theatre and cinematic environments.
courses.modules: Scenography, Costume Construction, Technical Design, Visual Storytelling

courses.title: BA (Hons) Visual Effects (VFX) for Film and Television
courses.overview: Technical and creative study of CGI, compositing, and digital environment building.
courses.modules: 3D Modelling, Compositing, Matchmoving, VFX Pipelines

courses.title: BA (Hons) Future Media Production
courses.overview: Exploring generative AI, virtual production, and interactive media technologies.
courses.modules: AI for Media, Virtual Production, Narrative Design, Interactive Tools

courses.title: MA Fashion Innovation
courses.overview: Focused on 3D fashion design, virtual fitting, and sustainable digital supply chains.
courses.modules: 3D Design, Virtual Prototyping, Innovation Strategy, Research

courses.title: MA Historical Costume
courses.overview: Advanced research into garment history and the reconstruction of historical dress.
courses.modules: Costume Analysis, Historical Methods, Advanced Construction, Thesis

courses.title: MA Illustration
courses.overview: Advanced development of narrative imagery and personal visual language.
courses.modules: Experimental Drawing, Narrative Theory, Visual Research, Project

courses.title: MA Photography
courses.overview: Explores experimental photography and critical theory at a professional level.
courses.modules: Visual Literacy, Contemporary Practice, Photographic Theory, Project

courses.title: MA Painting
courses.overview: Intensive studio-based program for establishing high-level contemporary painting practice.
courses.modules: Studio Methods, Critical Theory, Materiality, Professional Engagement

courses.title: MA Innovation and Creative Entrepreneurship
courses.overview: Developing leadership and start-up skills specifically for the creative sectors.
courses.modules: Business Strategy, Design Thinking, Venture Planning, Finance

courses.title: MA User Experience (UX/UI)
courses.overview: Focused on human-centered design, prototyping, and digital interface psychology.
courses.modules: UX Research, UI Design, Prototyping, Usability Testing

courses.title: MA Film Practice (Online)
courses.overview: Part-time online master's focused on high-level cinematic storytelling and production.
courses.modules: Screenwriting, Directing, Editing, Professional Development

courses.title: MA Interior Design (Online)
courses.overview: Advanced spatial design master's exploring sustainable and adaptive reuse of internal spaces.
courses.modules: Spatial Theory, Sustainable Design, Digital Visualization

courses.title: MA Landscape Architecture Studies (Online)
courses.overview: Examining the design and management of external environments and urban ecosystems.
courses.modules: Ecological Design, Urbanism, Landscape Theory, Visualization

courses.title: BA (Hons) Acting with Foundation Year
courses.overview: Four-year pathway for students needing an entry year to build acting foundations.
courses.modules: Academic Skills, Voice and Movement, Performance Basics

courses.title: BA (Hons) Animation Production with Foundation Year
courses.overview: Entry-level pathway to build artistic skills for animation production.
courses.modules: Visual Research, Character Design, Storyboarding, Academic Skills

courses.title: BA (Hons) Commercial Photography with Foundation Year
courses.overview: Four-year degree for students building photographic foundations.
courses.modules: Lighting Basics, Digital Imaging, Visual Literacy, Academic Skills

courses.title: BA (Hons) Communication Design and Strategy with Foundation Year
courses.overview: Bridging the entry gap for design thinking and strategic communication.
courses.modules: Design Process, Visual Communication, Academic Skills

courses.title: BA (Hons) Content Creation with Marketing with Foundation Year
courses.overview: Foundation pathway focusing on digital content and marketing basics.
courses.modules: Copywriting, Social Media Basics, Academic Skills, Branding

courses.title: BA (Hons) Costume with Foundation Year
courses.overview: Focused on building garment construction and design skills from entry level.
courses.modules: Construction Basics, Pattern Cutting, Costume History, Study Skills

courses.title: BA (Hons) Fashion with Foundation Year
courses.overview: Four-year pathway for developing high-level fashion design skills from entry level.
courses.modules: Design Process, Pattern Cutting, Illustration, Academic Skills

courses.title: BA (Hons) Film Production with Foundation Year
courses.overview: Entry-level pathway for the collaborative study of cinematic production.
courses.modules: Directing Basics, Camera Skills, Editing, Academic Skills

scholarships.name: AUB International Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Must be an international fee-payer; submission of a high-quality creative portfolio; must hold an offer of study for a full-time BA (Hons) degree; 500-word statement on 'How AUB will help me change the creative industry'.
scholarships.description: This competitive award recognizes exceptional creative talent. It provides a £5,000 reduction in the first year of tuition for undergraduate students who show significant potential in arts, design, or media.

scholarships.name: AUB International Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Hold an international fee-paying status; minimum 2:1 degree in a related creative field; strong digital portfolio submission; must be a full-time Master's applicant at the Bournemouth campus.
scholarships.description: A merit-based scholarship for international postgraduates aimed at fostering global perspectives within the AUB studio environment. The award is a £3,000 one-off reduction in the total Master's tuition fee.
